question: Does a valuable later event stop DP from reloading an earlier one?
hypothesis: H3 (headline): there is a later reward large enough that DP stops retrying an earlier event.
read_out: DP check (1 Nov): from a full 600 s budget DP retries early_target 30 times when the later event is removed or worth 10-20, 18 times at 40, and not at all at 80 or 160. Always-reload should lose most to DP at 80 and 160.
replaces: data/synthetic/experiment_D_future_opportunity (later event p = 0.5, c = 10 s was always won quickly, so its value never competed for time; see dp/README.md finding 2)
